ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the food web diagram, what change would cause moose to increase?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, organisms such as MOOSE (moose), EVERGREEN (evergreen tree), BLACK SPRUCE (black spruce), BLACK BEAR, GRAY WOLF, etc. are labeled. Observe the arrows connected to MOOSE; EVERGREEN has an arrow pointing to MOOSE, indicating that evergreen is the food or resource source of moose. Reasoning: In a food web, if a consumer's food source increases, the number of consumers usually also increases. Because evergreen points to moose, an increase in evergreen will cause moose to increase.
